description: A crowd of men in wide-brimmed hats and dark oilskin coats works along a stormy, surf-lashed shoreline. Several shovel sand into wooden wheelbarrow-style sluice boxes, and one pours water from a bucket through the box. Behind them a row of canvas tents glows with lamps and smoke rises from stovepipes under a heavy, dark sky. The image is an oil painting filling the frame edge to edge, with no visible text.
